scope: g3-authorization: negative evidence for the private-note fixture
cause: Verify protected reads and writes without enabling Twill.
decision: Accept Gate 3 technical verification only: real Laravel authorization middleware and an application ability were exercised with Twill disabled on test-only routes. Gate 2 approval remains required for real privilege assignments and deployment.
observed_result: A basic signed-in account and an account whose test grant was revoked received HTTP 403 on reads and writes. Denied requests did not reach the handlers or change the note. Revocation took effect without reauthentication.
regression_test: Foundation CI passed all three PrivateNoteAuthorizationTest cases and reported PASS for AuthAcceptanceTest, DisabledRoutesTest, GoogleSsoTest, and SsoReactivationTest. Full PHP summary: 57 passed, 2 skipped, 432 assertions. Neither skipped test is claimed as a pass.
limitations: Routes, accounts, grants, and note storage were test-only; grants and storage were in memory. This did not verify Google SSO on the fixture routes, production privilege assignments, database-backed revocation, or deployment readiness.
